in_sanskrit.name: सक्षम्
in_sanskrit.meaning: able, capable, competent, skilled, expert, strong, active, present

in_telugu.name: శఖ్మ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శఖ్ (shakhu) - able, competent, capable, powerful, శక్తి (sakti) - power, strength

in_marathi.name: Saksham
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Able to see or perceive
in_marathi.long_meaning: Saksham हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Saksham is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saksh' which means 'to witness'. The name Saksham means 'able to see or perceive' and is given to a child who is believed to have the ability to observe and understand the world around them with clarity and wisdom. This name is often given to a child who is expected to be courageous and truthful in their actions and words.
